disposition_reason: Table 7 gives median, mean, SD and 95% UCL of lead, cadmium, chromium and nickel in 775 orchard samples of apple, pear, peach, grape and jujube from China.

study.design: National orchard survey of heavy metals in five deciduous fruits with pollution indices and health risk
study.origin: orchards in main producing areas: Liaoning, Shaanxi, Shandong, Hebei, Xinjiang, Jiangsu, Henan, Anhui (118 counties)
study.market: not market samples; collected at harvest by authorized inspectors
study.method: Wet digestion (HNO3/H2O2) and graphite furnace AAS (GB 5009 methods)
lod: LOD Pb 5, Cd 0.1, Cr 2, Ni 2.8 ug/kg
study.qa: Reagent blanks and plant reference material GBW10052 (GSB-30) per batch of 20; results accepted when within one SD of certified values

findings.group: main producing areas of China (Hebei, Liaoning, Shandong, Shaanxi), harvest 2014, all samples
findings.notes: Orchard samples washed with distilled water and homogenized; basis not stated (no drying step described). Results below LOD were assigned 1/2 LOD before computing statistics.

unresolved: Minimum and maximum per fruit are not printed in Table 7 despite its title ('concentration ranges').
Statistics include 1/2 LOD substitution for non-detects.
Basis (fresh vs dry) is not stated explicitly.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Assessment standards used for single factor index (China)
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Pb 0.1 mg/kg apple, pear, peach; 0.2 mg/kg grape, jujube; Cd 0.05; Cr 0.5; Ni 0.3 mg/kg
Ni above 0.3 mg/kg in 2.2% of samples (apple 1.4%, pear 1.5%, peach 7.3%, grape 0.7%); Pb above 0.1 mg/kg in 0.4% (apple 0.5%, peach 1.5%)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: THQ and dietary intake rates (DIR) per fruit
regulatory_or_exposure.value: All THQ and TTHQ < 1 per text
